snippet_primary: > "The standard credit and debit card payment fee is 2.99% + a fixed fee per transaction, which varies according to the transaction currency. An additional 1.5% applies to international commercial transactions. Note that these fees are collected by PayPal and do not go to Payhip."
subject_exact: Fee de PayPal para tarjetas de crédito y débito: 2.99% + fee fija por transacción (variable según la moneda), más 1.5% adicional en transacciones comerciales internacionales; fees recaudadas por PayPal, no por Payhip
metric_value_raw: 2.99% + a fixed fee per transaction; additional 1.5% for international commercial transactions
local_qualifiers: which varies according to the transaction currency
Note that these fees are collected by PayPal and do not go to Payhip
parser_notes: Fees de terceros (PayPal) relayadas por el help center; capas declaradas. El monto de la fee fija no se declara en el snippet.
